//: The cfx-server build the dev harness runs on, pinned on purpose.
FiveM Enhanced replaced the old artifact server: builds no longer have an incrementing
number on runtime.fivem.net, they are published under an opaque release id on
downloads.cfx-services.net, and the executable was renamed FXServer -> cfx-server.
There is no 'latest' URL to follow, so both platforms are pinned by hand.
The two ids differ per platform but come from the same release — their UUIDv7 prefix
Bumping this is a deliberate PR, and it is when the @citizenfx/* typings in
